method: At the start of each hour use only two earlier valid LSA SAF slots; approximate MSG acquisition time; assumed source availability = original date_created + 2 minutes; 0.75 maximum satellite weight decaying with observation age over 120 minutes; no fitted target-day parameters; complete next-hour five-minute integration. Baseline is the frozen previous-day GFS v3.2 replay. Same actual hours including satellite fallback; no target-hour satellite input.
limitations: Retrospective component test, not independently held-out or genuinely as-issued forecasts. October was inspected in previous development.
Historical source creation timestamps exist, but actual historical delivery latency is unknown; receivedAt in raw archive remains today.
No historical ICON-EU or complete Huawei five-minute series for these days: this evaluates satellite on v3.2 background only, not the full live combined trial.
Short-term update has later weather observations than the day-ahead baseline; no claim of improved day-ahead accuracy.
Scan time and clear-sky irradiance are modeled. No optical-flow cloud motion or individual-panel shadow prediction.
